builder.description: Chart key: any-engineer = engineer battalion, engineer company or HQ with engineering capability; engineer-hq = any HQ with engineering capability; cw-engineer-hq = Commonwealth HQ with engineering capability; sgsu = any squadron ground support unit; cw-sgsu = Commonwealth SGSU; infantry-battalion-3toe = infantry-type battalion with at least 3 TOE points; nzrrc = NZ railway construction company; any-unit-1toe = any unit with at least 1 TOE point

hexes_per_stage.description: Own hex plus adjacent hexes this option may work in one stage, where the chart splits it by builder

builderOption.description: One way to satisfy the unit requirement; a row's builders list is the set of alternatives

hot_weather_extra_water.description: Extra water per item under construction (supply dumps excepted) when the hex is under hot weather (chart note *)

supplies.description: Per project, or per hex when supplies_per_hex is set

supplies_by_port.description: Port blocking: Tobruk costs more than any other port

cp.description: Capability points instead of stages (supply dumps)

hexes_per_stage.description: Own hex plus adjacent hexes worked in one stage, when not split by builder

one_at_a_time.description: Chart note ‡: only one may be built, rebuilt or blocked at a time

enemy_zoc_allowed.description: Row overrides the chart-wide rule (note †) that nothing is built in an enemy ZOC

rebuild_in_enemy_zoc_in.description: Terrain where a rebuild (only) may happen in an enemy ZOC

from_major_city.description: Building starts from a major city hex

head_only.description: Building extends the line one hex at a time from its head

exclusive_in_hex.description: No other construction in the hex meanwhile, except port and flying-boat work

ports_not.description: Ports this row may never be applied to

port_hexes.description: Hex printed on the chart for a port named in ports_not

fake_ratio_max.description: Fake dumps may not exceed this fraction of real dumps in play
